title: Implementation: kisi-fdtd against openEMS on the same mesh
text: Both tools with staircase metal on the mesh kisi-fdtd generates, PML in the outer 8 cells, the same lumped ports, Gaussian pulse and dielectric loss; port 1 excited. This checks the field updates, ports, PML and the geometry rules, not the accuracy of the metal model (the conformal model is checked against the analytic cavity and by mesh convergence).
